note: F-9: the river's working boats — architecture-tour boats and water taxis at their docks and under way, and a few pleasure boats heading out to the lake. Read by pipeline/lib/boats.js riverBoats. `at` is an approximate point in model metres (shared/project.js: origin State & Madison, +x east, +z south) read from maps and photographs; the build lays each boat against the river as built (moored: against the bank toward `side`, a compass bearing; underway: on the river's axis, `across` −1…1 from bank to bank, bow toward the bearing `bow`) and drops any boat that would not lie wholly on the water. Boats are generic: the class's look, no operator's livery or name. The scene is a still: a boat under way holds its place.
sources: https://www.architecture.org/tours/detail/chicago-architecture-center-river-cruise-aboard-chicagos-first-lady/ (tour boats leave from the Riverwalk at Michigan Avenue)
https://www.chicagowatertaxi.com/ (water-taxi stops along the main stem and the South Branch)
https://www.wendellaboats.com/ (tour boats from the Michigan Avenue Bridge, north-west)
